title: Get help
intro: Official hotlines and reporting lines. If someone is holding your passport, stopping you from leaving, or you feel in danger, call now.

pick.title: Pick your countries
pick.body: Choose where you are from and where you will work, and we show those hotlines first.

noneListed.title: No contacts listed
noneListed.body: We have not listed any contacts for your countries yet. You can choose different countries or look at all countries.

unverified: We have not verified an official hotline for {{country}} yet. Contact your nearest embassy or the police, or use the lines for the country you are in.
